publication.title: Filling the gaps of dinosaur eggshell phylogeny: Late Jurassic Theropod clutch with embryos from Portugal

age.basis: The paper assigns the clutch to the early Tithonian; the numeric envelope uses the current ICS Tithonian stage interval.
age.notes: The paper additionally reports the layer approximately 35 m above the Kimmeridgian-Tithonian boundary.

claims.summary: ML1188 is a roughly 65 cm-wide clutch assemblage containing more than 500 clustered eggshell fragments together with embryonic bones and teeth.
Embryonic osteology and associated eggshells are ascribed to the megalosaurid theropod Torvosaurus.
The clutch was recovered from a grey mudstone layer in the early Tithonian Sobral Member of the Lourinhã Formation.
